meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问式对话完善计划或设计，并同步生成 ADR 与术语表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在推进复杂方案时犹豫不决，需要有人帮你挖出逻辑漏洞并留下清晰记录。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pressure-test complex designs and keep a clear decision trail.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像面试官一样连续追问，帮你把一个计划或设计打磨得更清楚；过程中它会把关键决策写成 ADR（架构决策记录），并整理一份术语表。
howto.when: 当你想打磨某个计划或设计，并希望同步留下决策文档时，明确要求使用 grill-with-docs 就会触发。

say.text: 用 grill-with-docs 打磨这个数据库迁移方案。
say.note: Claude 会开始连番追问并记录决策。

say.text: 请以 grill-with-docs 方式审阅我的新功能设计，并输出文档。
say.note: 过程中会生成 ADR 和术语表。

say.text: 对这份 API 设计做一轮 grill-with-docs。
say.note: 它会拆解设计假设并留下记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a grilling interview: it keeps asking tough questions to sharpen a plan or design, and writes architecture decision records (ADRs) and a glossary as it goes.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you explicitly ask for a grill-with-docs session to refine a plan or design and capture decisions as docs.

say_en.text: Use grill-with-docs to sharpen this database migration plan.
say_en.note: Claude starts probing and records decisions.

say_en.text: Review my feature design with grill-with-docs and produce docs.
say_en.note: ADRs and a glossary will be created.

say_en.text: Run grill-with-docs on this API design.
say_en.note: It challenges assumptions and leaves a record.
